notes.wood-hall: OSM maps Wood Hall as three buildings (Wood Hall A, B, C; way/47933251, way/47933260, way/47933247), so no single name matched; pinned on Wood Hall A. NC State Facilities lists them together as WD1, Wood Residence Hall Buildings.
notes.wolf-village-apartments: Wolf Village is the group of apartment buildings A–H on Wolf Village Way (OSM Arctic, Caspian, Red, Timber, Mackenzie, Gray, Hudson halls); pinned on Gray Hall, Building G (way/47692850), in the middle. NC State Facilities: WVA, Wolf Village Apartment Buildings.
notes.wolf-ridge: Wolf Ridge Apartments, 1900 Entrepreneur Drive (NC State Facilities WR1); OSM has its buildings as Tower Hall (1910), Lakeview Hall (1913) and Plaza Hall (1940) Entrepreneur Drive; pinned on Tower Hall (way/297297481).
notes.sullivan-shops-ii: Facilities shops building, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.biological-resources-facility: Laboratory animal facility, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.west-chiller-plant: Chiller plant (utility), not somewhere classes happen.
notes.administrative-services-i: Administrative offices, not somewhere classes happen.

detours.why: Thomas Hall's mapped door is on its north side by the railroad; the buildings between it and these halls have no mapped way through, so walks go round its west end.
No mapped path crosses the athletics fields and the Weisiger-Brown facility north of Wood Hall, so walks go west along Warren Carroll Drive and round.
Reynolds Coliseum's mapped doors are on its east side, so walks from Alexander Hall to its west go round the building.
No mapped path crosses the ground between these halls and the building's mapped door, so walks go round by the nearest mapped walks.
